reviews.comment: There is no clear connection between the slides, homework assigned, the lab, or what he talks about in class. His failure to "understand technology" forced us to do complete 5 different homework assignments within a span of a week because he forgot to publish the assignments on Canvas. Delay taking this class if he is the only option.

Very boring lectures. You learn more by reading the textbook and paying attention in lab. The TAs are super helpful and will give points back on assignments and exams if you ask. He expects you to have more knowledge on the material than even the textbook. Exams were much harder than homework. He tends to assign 2 or 3 hw assignments due at a time.

He's very nice, but he's not a good teacher. The lectures are completely useless and he doesn't explain much. There's also a lot of homework. You learn more from the labs than from the lectures. The textbook doesn't help with absolutely everything but it's way better than his lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This is very important class to take if you interested in concert, the professor was very good and the class is excited, but you need to work hard to get an A.
He is a great professor that is welling to help everybody anytime.

Terrible at communicating with/responding to students; badly organized class. Syllabus was revised several times due to confusion about due dates. Over 20 hw assignments, all for 5% of your grade. Lectures unhelpful for understanding exam material. Unclear grading/material expectations. Badly written exams. Overall lack of care about the class.

Awful teacher. I've learned 100% of the material from the TA or on my own. Zollinger just does not give a single crap about his students. He clearly just wants to be off doing his research. He assigns a butt ton of worthless HW. To be clear I got over 100 on the first test so I'm not mad at him, he's just the worst
His lectures were so boring and honestly a waste of time. The textbook is all you need to do well on the hw and exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Zollinger never actually taught the material. I had him for 302 (Matlab) and he would just post some code during his lecture and tell us to copy it and run it. Never explained what was going on and then made the exams fairly difficult in comparison. Avoid this guy for this class if possible. Very quiet and horrendous at explaining material.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Surveying. Dr. Z. He knows his stuff, but explaining it to us was another thing. We were continuously confused by the material, if you can take Dr. Chinn. Even doing all the homework and doing well on it, I did not feel prepared for the tests at all.
